enonce.texte: Complete the sentences using the correct form of 'going to' and the verb in parentheses.
Choose between 'will' and 'going to' to complete the sentences.

questions.texte: She has bought a ticket. She ______ visit her aunt.
Don't worry! I ______ help you with that.
We have planned everything. We ______ have a party.

enonce.texte: Write 5 sentences about your future plans using 'going to'.

questions.reponse: Example: I am going to study English. I am going to visit my family. I am going to travel to Yaoundé. I am going to buy a new phone. I am going to start a new job.

enonce.texte: Rewrite the sentences in the negative form using 'going to'.

questions.texte: She is going to eat rice.
questions.reponse: She is not going to eat rice.

questions.texte: They are going to play tennis.
questions.reponse: They are not going to play tennis.

questions.texte: I am going to buy a car.
questions.reponse: I am not going to buy a car.

enonce.texte: Create questions using 'going to' from the prompts.

questions.reponse: Are you going to visit your parents?
Is she going to buy a new dress?
Are they going to travel to Cameroon?

enonce.texte: Write a short paragraph of 6 sentences about your future travel plans using 'going to'.

questions.reponse: Example: I am going to travel to Cameroon next year. I am going to visit Douala and Yaoundé. I am going to see my family. I am going to eat traditional food. I am going to take many pictures. I am going to enjoy my trip.

intitule: Exercise 7: Distinguishing 'Will' and 'Going To' in Context

questions.texte: A: What are your plans for the weekend? B: I ______ (visit) my grandmother.
A: I'm hungry. B: I ______ (make) you a sandwich.
A: Look at those clouds! B: It ______ (rain).

intitule: Exercise 8: Creating a Future Career Plan

enonce.texte: Write a detailed plan of 10 sentences about your future career goals using 'going to' and 'will'.

questions.reponse: Example: I am going to study engineering. I am going to go to university. I will work hard. I am going to get a job in a big company. I will save money. I am going to buy a house. I will travel for work. I am going to meet new people. I will learn new skills. I am going to become a successful professional.
